packageRules.description: Auto-merge in-range minor/patch once all CI checks pass (smoke would block a bad puppeteer bump).
Group the cockpit UI deps into one PR.
Majors get a standalone PR and a human (e.g. puppeteer/electron/typescript).

Never rewrite the published `engines` floor. It's a compatibility contract with consumers of `npx devloop-mcp`, derived from our runtime deps (puppeteer >=22.12.0) — not from whatever node CI happens to pin. #22 raised it to >=24.18.0 as a side effect of pinning the CI runner, silently dropping support for node 22 LTS.

Keep @types/node on the major matching `engines.node` (>=22.12.0). Typing against a newer node than we support lets tsc accept APIs that crash at runtime on the oldest node we claim to run on. Raise this only when the engines floor itself is raised.
